parts.problem_md: Explain **two **benefits to a business of preparing a bank reconciliation statement.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> **Award one mark for each identification of reason and one mark for development.**
> 
> **Sample answer**
> 
> Ensures that the cash book is up to date **(1)** by identifying missing standing orders etc. **(1)**.
> 
> Helps to detect errors in either the cash book or the bank statement** (1)** enabling corrective action to be taken **(1)**
> 
> **Accept any other appropriate responses.**

parts.problem_md: State **one **benefit of preparing a bank reconciliation statement.

> 
> To check for any errors made by the bank** (1)**

parts.problem_md:
Define the following terms.

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| Unpresented cheques |   |
| Outstanding lodgements |   |
| Dishonoured cheque |   |
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> **Award marks as indicated.**
> 
> | Term | Definition |
> |---|---|
> | Unpresented cheques | Cheques entered in the cash book, not yet presented for payment to the bank. **(1)** |
> | Outstanding lodgements | Receipts entered in the cash book and banked that have not yet been processed by the bank **(1)** |
> | Dishonoured cheque | A cheque received or paid that the bank has refused to pay **(1)** |
> 
> **Accept any other appropriate responses.**
